context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren discuss hiring contractors.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business HR; employment vocabulary (採用/雇用/工場/確保/業者) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 工場の人員を、確保したいんだ。
lines.en: I want to secure factory staff.
lines.style: decisive boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 採用は、何名の予定ですか?
lines.style: attentive young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 正社員を、十名ほど採用したい。
lines.en: I'd like to hire about ten full-time staff.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 足りなければ、業者にも頼めますか?
lines.en: If short, can we also rely on contractors?
lines.style: thoughtful young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 信頼できる業者を、確保しておこう。
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 雇用の条件は、良くしたいですね。
lines.en: I'd like to make the employment terms good.
lines.style: earnest young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 良い雇用が、良い人を集める。
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 工場の採用、計画を立てます。
lines.en: I'll draw up the factory hiring plan.
lines.style: reliable young manager voice, soft warm resolved closing throughout
